system.description:
Range: 10 Spaces

You create a ward to keep malicious spirits away.

Choose a willing target within 10 Spaces. Until the start of your next turn, spirits, demons, and sacred beasts have Disadvantage on any checks made against that creature.

Alternatively, you may spend an extended amount of time to ward a place to prevent such creatures from entering it.

If you concentrate on this ability for 1 minute you may ward a 5 space radius for 10 minutes.

If you concentrate on this ability for 10 minutes you may ward a 10 space radius for 1 hour.

If you concentrate on this ability for 1 hour, you may ward a 30 space radius for 1 day.

If you concentrate on this ability for 1 day, you may ward a 50 space radius for 1 week.

If you concentrate on this ability for 1 week, you may ward a 100 space radius for 1 year.

Spirits, demons, and sacred beasts must make a Willpower check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics) to enter a warded space. They have Disadvantage on this check.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.j0RORElGtVF0Jnzh]{Warding of Urdokai}
